pattern: roll a d20 for each player being attacked and ignore all but the highest roll

examples.text:
Whenever you attack, roll a d20 for each player being attacked and ignore all but the highest roll.
1-9 | You gain 1 life.
10-20 | Each opponent loses 1 life.

Whenever this creature and at least one other creature attack, roll a d20 for each player being attacked and ignore all but the highest roll.
1-10 | Draw a card.
11-20 | You gain 2 life.

counterExamples:
Whenever you attack, roll a d20 for each player being attacked and ignore all but the lowest roll.
1-9 | You gain 1 life.
10-20 | Each opponent loses 1 life.

Whenever you attack, roll a d20 for each opponent and ignore all but the highest roll.
1-9 | You gain 1 life.
10-20 | Each opponent loses 1 life.

Whenever you attack, roll two d20 and ignore all but the highest roll.
1-9 | You gain 1 life.
10-20 | Each opponent loses 1 life.
